meta_reflection: The operative finding is observability, not speed: with the authoritative block at 0/0/0 there is no wall-time to recover, so the realistic execution time-saving is ~0%. The value this milestone is making the retro pipeline trustworthy — fixing the detector false-zero so future retros analyze real timing rather than honoring a block that disagrees with the on-disk record. Reporting the zeros honestly (no fabricated IDs, durations, or metrics) is the correct anti-hallucination-compliant outcome.
